analysis.summary: Management stated that JG Chemicals delivered its best-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, reaching all-time new highs in quarterly revenue, EBITDA, and PAT. The company is experiencing robust demand across end-user applications like tires, rubber, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture, supported by double-digit volume growth. Operational capacity expansions, including the Dahej greenfield facility and Naidupeta brownfield project, are on track for commissioning in Q3 FY27. Management also highlighted ongoing cost-optimization initiatives and the development of new niche products to drive future margin expansion towards 14% to 15%. J.G.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% to 15% due to higher-margin value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: Management targets a minimum capacity utilization of 50% to 60% for the Dahej plant in its first full year of operations.
guidance.quote: I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

guidance.claim: The management expects the Dahej facility to reach peak utilization around FY29.
guidance.quote: We would inch up to close to 80%, and that is where we would go in for the next phase of expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA data showed Q1 FY27 volume growth across major vehicle categories including passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, commercial vehicles, and three-wheelers.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand and volume growth were observed across all end-user applications in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories as reported by ATMA.
demand_outlook.quote: As Per ATMA, Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories — PV +26.6% YoY, 2W +16.58% YoY, CV +16.48% YoY, 3W +11.32% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors are expanding their capacities to cater to OEM demand despite recent crises.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the recent West Asia crisis, the Indian tyre majors are expanding their capacities to cater to the OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Estimated Capex of about INR 25,000 crore has been announced by tyre majors according to recent ATMA reports.
demand_outlook.quote: As per recent ATMA reports, an estimated Capex of about INR 25,000 crore has been announced by tyre majors.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry was extremely robust through the fourth quarter and continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand momentum across tire industry was extremely robust right through the fourth quarter and the same momentum has continued in the current quarter as well as we speak.

demand_outlook.claim: Outside rubber and tires, the company continues to see encouraging traction across the non-rubber portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: Outside the rubber and the tire, we continue to see very encouraging traction across the non-rubber portfolio, namely the pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, electronics, agriculture, to name a few.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is currently not witnessing any slowdown from the tire industry.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currently we are not witnessing any slowdown from the tire industry and what we hear that the demand for tires is quite strong in the market and even our projections what they have given for the month of June are almost at par with what was there in April and May.

capex_expansion.claim: The Gujarat greenfield project in Dahej involves an investment of about INR 100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR 900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej facility will add between 15,000 and 17,000 tons per annum of capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is targeted for commissioning in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai as a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited, a material subsidiary of JG Chemicals, and consequently a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of JG Chemicals Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel with commissioning expected in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction at the Dahej site is in advanced stages and machinery installation has commenced during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Civil construction at the Dahej site is now in advanced stages, and equipment, plant and machinery installation has also commenced during the quarter as we speak.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has undertaken brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support future demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside Dahej, we have also undertaken certain brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support the future demand.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 grew 44.8% year-on-year to INR 315.7 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR 36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5%.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 stood at INR 26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company is neutral to zinc price fluctuations.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly. So, whether zinc is at 3,000 or 3,500 or 3,600, it really doesn't matter to us.

margins_costs.claim: All incremental costs including higher freight, energy, and ancillary costs have been transparently passed on to customers effective April 1, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: In line with our long-standing pricing philosophy, all of these incremental costs, including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs, have been transparently passed on to all our customers with effect from 1st April 2026 itself.

margins_costs.claim: Current EBITDA margins usually operate in the 10% to 11% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see our current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range, and as we've mentioned before, higher value-added products would help increase the blended margins to the 13% to 14% range.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity across West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream.
orders_capacity.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

orders_capacity.claim: Customer franchise extends to over 200 domestic customers and over 50 international customers.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, our customer franchise extends to more than 200 domestic customers and over 50 international customers.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization levels stood in the early 80s during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization rates for zinc oxide are in the late 70s.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current utilization rates are in the late 70s, and we can easily take this up to the 86% to 87% range as required.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc sulphate capacity utilization runs at approximately 60% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The zinc sulphate business, which has gradually been growing, is today running at approximately 60% of the installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 1 of the solar power generation project at Naidupeta was commissioned in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In keeping with this sustainability agenda, I am pleased to inform you that we have commissioned Phase 1 of our solar power generation project at Naidupeta in FY26, which has progressively been ramping up our share of renewable energy.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts have severely impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: JGC's scale, financial strength, and supplier relationships ensured uninterrupted raw material supply during recent months despite global supply chain disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts caused a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and huge delays in shipments from Europe during March.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the month of March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and also there were huge delays in shipments from Europe.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej project is estimated to be commissioned around November.
management_commitments.quote: I would say, it will be sometime in November would be a good estimate.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to commission the Naidupeta brownfield expansion in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to continue the strong performance momentum going forward.
management_commitments.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

management_commitments.claim: Once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum.
management_commitments.quote: With the Gujarat project being commissioned during the current financial year, and once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum, a scale which is perhaps matched today globally by only a few players.

management_commitments.claim: New customized product varieties for customers' compounding process will be introduced in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Our R&D team is working on developing some other varieties of zinc oxide also, which will further aid our customers' compounding process. These products would be introduced in the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to have completely debottlenecked the Naidupeta facility by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: So, this is a gradual process which is going on, and we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
